objective: Exploratory experiment: classify every collar type of the 96,416 domino-torus planes of ONE-BIT-20261108-001B by the number of cuts after which it becomes a pinwheel collar (one, two or three), keep the planes all of whose collars do so within three cuts, and test the last one-bit decoration (10101 / 00110 and its relabelling) on each new distinct plane: a periodic labelling of its k-fold cut obeying the labelled law, for k from the first legal cut to two more, on tori of index 1 or 2.
status: Closed, supported (exploratory, LAST-BIT-20261108-001A-E001): of the 5,376 collar types of the 96,416 domino-torus planes, 82 are in the level-one law, 54 cut into it, and none needs exactly three cuts, so the family holds no crystal legal only after three cuts and the crystal search for the last decoration, 10101 / 00110, is exhausted in it.
title: Crystals legal only after three cuts
